summary: The scopes come in the order they are to be offered, each with the number the whole index holds, so the pills stay right whichever one is pressed.

then.note: scopes is [{id: pages, label: …, count: 12}, {id: components, label: …, count: 3}]; the panel puts «All» before them with the sum. A host that answers one page of results answers count over the whole index, and total beside the results; a host that leaves count out has the panel count the results it holds.
